engine: bydorr's signature text reveal — a multi-line passage that, on scroll, reveals CHARACTER BY CHARACTER from left to right: the settled head is solid, while the chars at the reveal EDGE are SCRAMBLED (each glyph rotated + offset + faded) and tumble into place as the scroll advances. A scroll-scrubbed per-glyph scramble-settle. Harvested from D_bydorr (the 'Feel because you have a heart... laugh, love, and sleep.' poem reveal).

measured_teardown.move: one pinned scroll-scrub, progress p 0..1. The text is split into per-character spans (spaces preserved). Each char i owns a window [i/N*spread .. +charWin] along p (left-to-right cascade, spread = 1-charWin). Inside its window the char eases from a SEEDED scrambled state (translate (dx0,dy0) within +/-chaos px, rotate r0 = chaos*0.7 deg, opacity 0) to settled (0,0,0deg,1), power3.out. Seeds are fixed per char at init via a deterministic PRNG (mulberry32-ish) so the scramble doesn't jitter frame to frame.
measured_teardown.cited: bydorr: 'Feel because you have a heart / And let it guide you through the dark / For it's the well of emotions deep / That helps you laugh, love, and sleep.' — head solid, edge characters jumbled/rotating into place, revealed left-to-right as you scroll; a faint X/Y crosshair readout + a 'W.' honors marker sit alongside (not part of this brick).

chaos.what: max scramble offset for each char's start; rotation = chaos*0.7 deg. Higher = wilder tumble.

charWin.what: fraction of total progress each char takes to settle (its window length). Smaller = sharper per-char snap; the cascade spread = 1-charWin.

pinFactor.what: length of the pinned scroll span = how long the whole passage takes to assemble.

seed.what: deterministic scramble seed — same seed => same per-char scramble vectors (stable, no jitter).

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when the page drives a shared Lenis (lab sets false).

entry: ScrambleSettleText.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), chars, destroy }. target = .sst-stage wrapping .sst-text (plain text, or [data-line] blocks for explicit lines). The JS splits the text into .sst-char spans. set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub (0 all scrambled, 1 all settled).
law: transform: translate + rotate per char + opacity only; GPU; NO filter / NO mix-blend; NO WebGL; reduced-motion or <=820px -> all settled (no pin). owns_pin TRUE. Scramble seeds are deterministic (PRNG seeded once) — never Math.random per frame. GSAP + ScrollTrigger required for the scroll path; set(p) standalone.
gate_mode: owns_pin scroll-scrub. Verify the LEFT-TO-RIGHT edge: at a mid p the head chars are settled (opacity 1, transform 0) while the edge chars are still scrambled (opacity <1, non-zero translate/rotate) and the tail is invisible. Smoothness with the full char count transforming per frame.
proven: lab: a 4-line UA passage (62 chars) on white paper. Curve measured live (p / first-char / mid-char / last-char): 0 / scrambled,op0 / scrambled,op0 / scrambled,op0 -> 0.5 / settled,op1 / settling,op0.88 / scrambled,op0 -> 1 / settled / settled / settled. The reveal edge advances left-to-right (first settled while last still scrambled at p=0.5). Mid-reveal screenshot: lines 1-2 solid, line 3 'Дер а н о' with the edge glyphs rotated/offset/fading into place (matches bydorr b_006/b_014). Probe (4x CPU throttle, 62 chars transforming/frame): 1/684 long frames (0.1%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors.
